How to add to your Alpha theme
1
Go to Shopify Admin → Online Store → Themes
2
Click Actions → Edit code
3
Open Layout → theme.liquid
4
Paste both blocks just before the closing </head> tag
5
Wrap each in <script type="application/ld+json"> ... </script>
